content.text: The agreement expressly disclaims exclusivity in our favor, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: Section 1 (Kubient Services) expressly negates exclusivity and confirms that AP remains free to offer Inventory through other agents or sell to third parties, which matches our preferred position of no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on the Customer. The only other "exclusive" references are a non-exclusive license grant to us (p0002), exclusive jurisdiction (p0064), each Party's ownership of its own marks (p0065), the entire-agreement clause (p0072) and a no-third-party-beneficiary clause (p0073) — none of which restrict our procurement freedom. Searches for requirements/preferred-supplier, non-compete and "Customer shall not" restrictions returned nothing relevant.
